proposed_widenings.name: area.shape.cylinder
proposed_widenings.justification: Magic Circle creates a 10-ft-radius, 20-ft-tall cylinder. The current area shape vocabulary only supports sphere.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You create a 10-foot-radius, 20-foot-tall Cylinder of magical energy centered on a point on the ground

proposed_widenings.name: Duration.slot_scaled_timed
proposed_widenings.justification: Duration increases by 1 hour per slot level above 3. No current Duration variant supports slot-scaling; the timed variant carries a fixed DurationValue only.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The duration increases by 1 hour for each spell slot level above 3.

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation.block_travel
proposed_widenings.justification: Movement blocking (can't enter cylinder by nonmagical means) maps to the v4 block_travel atom but that atom is not surfaced in OngoingOperation.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The creature can't willingly enter the Cylinder by nonmagical means.

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation.save_gate_on_entry_attempt
proposed_widenings.justification: Teleportation/interplanar travel triggers a CHA saving throw to enter. This is a save gate fired by a movement event, not a cast-time phase — no existing OngoingOperation variant covers it.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If the creature tries to use teleportation or interplanar travel to do so, it must first succeed on a Charisma saving throw.

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation.modify_roll_advantage_scoped
proposed_widenings.justification: Affected creature types have Disadvantage on attack rolls against targets inside the cylinder. modify_roll_advantage is a v4 atom but is absent from OngoingOperation; it also needs a creature-type scope predicate (affecting specific creature types, not the caster or a mark).
proposed_widenings.evidence: The creature has Disadvantage on attack rolls against targets within the Cylinder.

proposed_widenings.name: block_condition_from_source
proposed_widenings.justification: Targets inside cannot gain the Charmed or Frightened condition from affected creature types. This is ongoing condition immunity scoped to a specific creature-type source. block_targeting covers targeting selection; remove_condition removes existing conditions; neither represents 'a creature of type X cannot inflict condition Y on targets inside the area'. No v4 atom covers this.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Targets within the Cylinder can't be possessed by or gain the Charmed or Frightened condition from the creature.

proposed_widenings.name: creature_type_filter
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell's effects apply only to a caster-chosen subset of creature types (Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, Undead). No current surface type models a creature-type scope filter on an area attachment or its operations.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose one or more of the following types of creatures: Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, or Undead.

proposed_widenings.name: area_effect_direction_toggle
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell can be reversed at cast time: rather than keeping affected creatures out, it keeps them in and protects targets outside. This binary mode has no surface representation.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Each time you cast this spell, you can cause its magic to operate in the reverse direction, preventing a creature of the specified type from leaving the Cylinder and protecting targets outside it.

notes: Magic Circle maps conceptually to the ongoing_effect family (timed area effect, no concentration), but cannot be honestly encoded. The critical atom_widening is block_condition_from_source: the rule that targets inside cannot be possessed by or gain Charmed/Frightened from affected creature types is scoped condition-source immunity, distinct from both block_targeting (which governs targeting selection) and remove_condition (which clears existing conditions). All other gaps are surface variants of existing shapes. The cylinder shape, slot-scaled duration, and creature-type scope filter would all require surface_widening; the triggered save-gate on teleportation entry and the scoped attack disadvantage operation also need new OngoingOperation variants.
